spanish: Y dijo Moisés a ellos: Varón no deje sobrar de nosotros hasta la mañana.
grammarChanges: Changed 'de él' to 'de nosotros' because h02016019007 (מִמֶּ֖נּוּ) is tagged suffix 1st common plural, not 3rd masculine singular.
Changed 'hasta mañana' to 'hasta la mañana' so h02016019008-009 (עַד בֹּקֶר, 'morning') reads as the noun and not the adverb 'tomorrow'.
Removed the comma after 'Varón' so h02016019004/h02016019006 (אִישׁ ... יוֹתֵר, 3ms jussive subject) is not misread as a direct address taking 'usted'.
